from solution import remove_tuple


def test_issue_example_from_description():
    """Remove duplicates from the given tuple as in the example."""
    # unique {1,3,5,2} sorted [1,2,3,5] => (1, 2, 3, 5)
    assert remove_tuple((1, 3, 5, 2, 3, 5, 1, 1, 3)) == (1, 2, 3, 5)


def test_issue_empty_tuple():
    """Remove duplicates from empty tuple gives empty tuple."""
    # unique {} sorted [] => ()
    assert remove_tuple(()) == ()


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Remove duplicates from a single-element tuple keeps it."""
    # unique {7} sorted [7] => (7,)
    assert remove_tuple((7,)) == (7,)


def test_issue_already_sorted_unique():
    """Remove duplicates leaves an already sorted unique tuple unchanged."""
    # unique {1,2,3,4} sorted [1,2,3,4] => (1, 2, 3, 4)
    assert remove_tuple((1, 2, 3, 4)) == (1, 2, 3, 4)


def test_issue_unsorted_unique_is_sorted():
    """Remove duplicates returns sorted order as shown in the example."""
    # unique {3,1,2} sorted [1,2,3] => (1, 2, 3)
    assert remove_tuple((3, 1, 2)) == (1, 2, 3)


def test_issue_all_elements_same():
    """Remove duplicates collapses all-same tuple to one element."""
    # unique {2} sorted [2] => (2,)
    assert remove_tuple((2, 2, 2, 2)) == (2,)


def test_issue_unsorted_with_duplicates():
    """Remove duplicates from unsorted tuple with repeats gives sorted unique."""
    # unique {5,4,3} sorted [3,4,5] => (3, 4, 5)
    assert remove_tuple((5, 4, 5, 4, 3, 5)) == (3, 4, 5)


def test_issue_negative_and_zero_duplicates():
    """Remove duplicates handles negative numbers and zero."""
    # unique {-1,0,-2} sorted [-2,-1,0] => (-2, -1, 0)
    assert remove_tuple((-1, 0, -1, -2, 0)) == (-2, -1, 0)


def test_issue_adjacent_duplicates():
    """Remove duplicates collapses adjacent repeats to one each."""
    # unique {1,2,3} sorted [1,2,3] => (1, 2, 3)
    assert remove_tuple((1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3)) == (1, 2, 3)


def test_contract_returns_tuple():
    """Function remove_tuple must return a tuple."""
    # unique {2,1} sorted [1,2] => check type is tuple
    result = remove_tuple((2, 1, 2))
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)


def test_contract_input_tuple_unchanged():
    """Function remove_tuple must not modify the given input tuple."""
    # input (3, 2, 3, 1) must stay (3, 2, 3, 1) after call
    data = (3, 2, 3, 1)
    remove_tuple(data)
    assert data == (3, 2, 3, 1)
